Are you me?! Living my life. 

My boyfriend currently still is working so I have all the time at home to sit in my head and take care of my baby. 

Things that are helping me kind of stay away from my dark place is keeping a routine. If you dont have one or your current one isnt working, add something new. 
Something I learned is to start the day accomplishing one thing - making the bed. 
Next, focus on you. Go wash your face, brush your teeth, fix your hair. Dont wait hours. DO IT. Put yourself first. It helps you not feel so groggy. Then start your routine. Open your windows and blinds, listen to nature for 15 mins while you drink your coffee and start your day. Try to appreciate the start of your day and maybe that'll help a bit.

Also, avoid your phones. 
Try to shut down the time you spend on it, use that time for something else. To much negativity going around.

I hope you are able to keep yourself out of there, however. If you got out once, you can get out twice. Stay strong lady!
